# Issue Template

## Description
Provide a clear description of the task, feature, or bug being addressed.

Explain what needs to be done and why it is important.

## Acceptance Criteria
List the specific requirements that must be met for this issue to be considered complete.

- [ ] Requirement 1
- [ ] Requirement 2
- [ ] Requirement 3

## Implementation Notes (Optional)
Provide any technical guidance that may help developers complete the task.

- Relevant files or components
- Suggested approach
- Dependencies or potential challenges

## Additional Resources (Optional)
Include any relevant documentation, designs, screenshots, or related issues.
